question:
some of the equations are provided below with symbols and mathematical relations you have to check which of the following combination is correct

If A ✚ B = (A × B) - (A + B), what is 6 ✚ 3?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ccc79497c8cdaa086c325840205326971b026abf5c7761597a4998318dea2b8.png] **
Mathematical relation: A ✚ B = (A × B) − (A + B)

Values to evaluate: A = 6 and B = 3

⇒ 6 ✚ 3 = (6 × 3) − (6 + 3)

⇒ 6 ✚ 3 = 18 − (9)

⇒ 6 ✚ 3 = 9

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 1**”.
